title: A production team's reproducible setup
purpose: See how a team turns shared configuration into identical developer machines.
explanation: One dotfiles repo holds the shell, git, and editor config. An install script links those files onto each new laptop, and a `.nvmrc` that pins an LTS version keeps every machine on the same Node runtime.
alt: A dotfiles repo feeds an install script, which reproduces a developer laptop. A Long-Term Support policy sets the version a `.nvmrc` file pins, and that file pins the same Node version on every laptop.

learning_check.question: A new hire's Node differs from the team's. Which file makes it match?
learning_check.answer: The shared `.nvmrc`, which pins the LTS version the policy chose.
